mcp_tools.name: long_form_authoring_pipeline
mcp_tools.title: Long-form authoring pipeline
mcp_tools.description: Submits a long-form authoring pipeline record (outline as contract, drafting loop, review passes, versioning and builds, publishing, feedback loop and red lines) and returns a deterministic AUTHORING_PIPELINE_SOUND / AUTHORING_PIPELINE_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed per-unit single-point and review-pass coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it writes nothing and runs no build.

inputSchema.description: The long-form authoring pipeline manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
